sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

You give each cost driver's weight as well as its movement—it sounds like you want the price discussion anchored in the cost build-up. We can discuss a longer contract in return for a lower base price, with a transparent basis for both sides. How would that exchange change your calculation, and could you share the cost-breakdown XLSX so we can review the material component?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -8.5% from 2024-11 to 2025-10 (idx:AS-14404@2024-11, idx:AS-14404@2025-10). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08). Our recent orders for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled were at 5.26, 5.84 per 1 (po:4500014292-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10). Our current contract passes PPI-C2431 on at 80% weight (ctr:4600070740#3.2), while your quote states it is 38% of your cost; that clause has already raised our price by 11% this year. Other suppliers currently quote this part at about EUR 5.45. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.76 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. We appreciate the 24-month volume commitment, but we must include the AS-14404 index clause as a fixed price over this duration is not feasible. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Please send us the competing offer you mentioned.

Our offer is a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

With the 24-month contract and the index clause, we can offer a revised price of €5.30 per unit. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Another package is a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

Your repeated emphasis on the index clause suggests that protection against material-cost swings is essential to a longer agreement. We are prepared to address that exposure in exchange for a lower base price that supports a durable commercial relationship. How can you translate the value of that risk protection into a more competitive base price?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. To meet you, we now move to 14 days payment. Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.87 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 0% deadband), 14 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We appreciate your acceptance of the AS-14404 index clause and the move to 14 days payment. Our current Angebot consists of a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer remains valid for 30 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
